stories.title: Zimbabwe's Kariba ferry disaster victims honoured as death toll reaches 44
stories.summary: Hundreds gathered for a memorial service in northern Zimbabwe on Thursday to honour victims of the Lake Kariba ferry disaster, which killed at least 44 people. Survivors recalled a desperate struggle for life as the vessel capsized in rough waters.
